protocol_definition.scope: Controlled recovery extension using official released retail tasks, tools, policy and unchanged evaluator; distinct from unmodified benchmark results
protocol_definition.injection_rule: First successful get_user_details response, one injection per run; never reinject after rollback
protocol_definition.source_detector: Earliest version-matched recorded read whose canonical content/error differs on deterministic re-execution; after at least one downstream step; hidden injection labels excluded
protocol_definition.dependency_rule: Model/user generations depend on observed prefix; calls depend on producing dispatch and prior writes; database-version-keyed read cache; conservative closure
protocol_definition.safe_restore: Retail-only in-memory copy of agent/user states, pending message/routing, trajectory, local counters and DB; global attempt/time/usage counts never reset
protocol_definition.primary_measure: Official evaluator reward conditional on fault exercised; also report unconditioned reward and coverage
protocol_definition.failure_reporting: Provider/runtime/evaluator failures retained with null reward; fault not reached marked not exercised; no favorable-result replacement
protocol_definition.analysis: Paired task/fault/seed results, denominators and coverage; descriptive intervals only with sample counts; no significance claim from pilot
notes: Faults are researcher-defined; public tasks/evaluator do not make the fault protocol an official recovery benchmark.
Seed does not guarantee identical provider output or deterministic paired trajectories.
Source rollback and selective recovery may coincide under conservative dependencies; do not tune faults to force an advantage.
Full matrix is planned, not yet completed. Published recovery methods are not relabeled as implemented.
v4 starts a separate comparison group. Earlier live outcomes do not evaluate corrected mechanisms. Cache-hit counts alone do not establish net work savings.

Adaptive is a fixed heuristic: observed error flag routes to verbal_correction; all other read mismatches route to source_rollback. It receives no injected fault-type label. Routing is not claimed optimal.

Verbal correction re-reads against the restored DB and replaces matching pending/history tool messages by call ID, requestor and original value. It does not guarantee repair of derived reasoning. Failed delivery is an ungraded execution failure.

Reflection is a controller-authored user message in agent state and trajectory, inserted before the outstanding assistant tool call. It is not model-generated reflection. Failed insertion is not silently ignored.
protocol_definition.cache_reuse_rule: After selective recovery only; exact tool/arguments/requestor/DB-hash match; saved value independently revalidated against restored DB; detected source and errors excluded; writes never cached. Equal tool outputs do not establish reasoning independence.
protocol_definition.timeout_semantics: Cooperative upstream timeout, not a hard deadline. Report elapsed time and overruns separately from official reward.
